summary: Reproduced the conceptual framework of Sensitivity-Constrained Fourier Neural Operators (SC-FNO), including the FNO architecture, Sensitivity Loss (Ls), and Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) Loss (Leq). Implemented a conceptual differentiable solver for data generation and structured a training script to demonstrate integration of these components for FNO, SC-FNO, and SC-FNO-PINN configurations. The README details the status, assumptions, and directory structure.
